- Continue the previously checkpointed "HUNTED // NIGHT SHIFT" Manhunt-style browser game and finish/polish it so it is fully playable on phone/tablet and desktop.

## Requirements
- (none stated beyond the request to continue and finish the game)

## Decisions
- Preserve the existing self-contained, no-build, no-external-asset architecture.
- Treat the game as one complete mission with 3 lieutenants, 5 regular hunters, touch controls, optional tilt, and extraction van.
- Fix gameplay defects found through browser playtesting rather than rewriting systems.

## Work State
### Completed
- Loaded the game successfully at `http://localhost:8000/?debug=1`; no console errors.
- Verified title screen, desktop HUD, mobile portrait HUD, and landscape title/game layouts via screenshots.
- Verified start, movement, touch joystick, crouch, throw, pickup, execution, win, loss, restart, and enemy AI behavior.
- Fixed enemies spawning inside solids and freezing:
  - Vance spawn/waypoint moved from `610,380` to `610,400`.
  - Dog spawn/waypoint moved from `300,1360` to `300,1400`.
  - Rook, Mace, and Tin waypoints moved out of props.
  - Bat pickup moved from `175,1290` to `175,1305`.
- Added `depenetrate(ent, r)` in `js/game.js` and calls in `resetWorld`, `updatePlayer`, and `updateEnemyAI`.
- Fixed stealth execution impossibility: `canSeePlayer` now always respects the enemy facing cone; chase state gets a wider FOV.
- Added LOS requirement to `findAttackTarget` so melee cannot hit through walls.
- Fixed initial hunter count in `index.html` from `7` to `8`.
- Made `localStorage` access safe in private/sandboxed contexts.
- Cleared queued input when resuming from pause.
- Fixed touch sprint being cancelled when lifting the separate joystick finger by tracking `sprintPointer` in `js/input.js`.
- Updated README wording from "Procedural top-down kill-floor map" to "Detailed top-down kill-floor map".
- Ran `node --check` on changed JS, `git diff --check`, and a free-space/nav validation script; all passed.

### Active
- Final review and commit of the uncommitted changes.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Run one final browser smoke test after the latest `js/input.js` change.
2. Review `git diff` for the four modified files.
3. Commit the changes to the current branch `opencode/41243286884`.
4. Optionally verify the commit and report completion.

## Relevant Files
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/js/game.js`: core simulation; contains depenetration, FOV/execution fix, LOS attack fix, pause input clear, safe storage.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/js/input.js`: touch/keyboard input; latest sprint pointer-ID fix.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/js/map.js`: enemy spawns, patrol waypoints, pickup positions.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/index.html`: initial hunter count corrected to 8.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/README.md`: feature wording corrected.
- `/tmp/opencode/free2.mjs`: validation script checking enemy/pickup positions are collision-free and nav-free.
- `/tmp/opencode/check.mjs`: earlier nav/path validation script.
- `/tmp/opencode/final-play.png`: latest desktop gameplay screenshot.
- `/tmp/opencode/mobile-play.png`: mobile portrait gameplay screenshot.
- `/tmp/opencode/landscape-title.png`: landscape title screenshot.

## Important Context
- Working tree has uncommitted modifications to `README.md`, `index.html`, `js/game.js`, `js/input.js`, and `js/map.js`.
- Current branch: `opencode/41243286884`; HEAD is `705fc4a` ("Save game and conversation for issue #3").
- GitHub issue #4 is the resume request: "Continue where you left off and finish the game."
- Static server is running on port 8000 from the project directory; `playwright-cli` session name is `hunted`.
- Chromium was installed via `playwright-cli install-browser chromium`.
- Use `window.__hunted` with `?debug=1` for test teleportation and state inspection.
- The game is winnable: execute all 3 lieutenants, then enter `EXIT_ZONE`; verified win stats and end screen.
- The game is losable: player death shows the "YOU WERE HUNTED." end screen.
